items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow'
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) {n : ℕ} (hn : p.natDegree < n) : p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) : p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.Monic.as_sum
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} (hp : p.Monic) : p = Polynomial.X ^ p.natDegree + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p.natDegree, Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i
